NetBlueprint Forge takes bug reports and feature requests, not code: the software is written by DigitalPrez, LLC alone so that its commercial licence stays simple ([CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/digitalprezllc/netblueprint-forge/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md) says why). A pull request from outside the organization is closed on arrival, without review, and nothing from it is merged.

If you ran into a problem, please describe it instead: https://github.com/digitalprezllc/netblueprint-forge/issues/new/choose
